title: The Wind Drawing in the Grass
youtube_title: The Wind Drawing in the Grass | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small beautiful thing can be shared with the eyes only.
summary: At a harbor wall at low tide, Greta finds a wind drawing silver lines in the meadow. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Greta shows Suri how to look without disturbing it. the ferryman looks too, and they leave it where it is.
